purpose: Repeat the Safari canvas discovery with the P3A oracle corrected to distinguish successful resolution processing from RESOLVED versus UNRESOLVED target state.
requiredClaims: Safari user state remains protected by preflight and in-test guards.
The real Safari Provider is used with loopback-only test content.
The target is physically RESOLVED by the product local Vision provider and the deterministic postcondition is physically UNRESOLVED with zero exact matches before action.
A fresh Safari semantic snapshot produces structured NO_SEMANTIC_TARGET for the canvas target.
The visual click is explicitly authorized through the existing P3B policy and delivered through real Computer Control.
CLICK_POSTED remains delivery only with semanticConsequenceVerified=false.
A fresh independent post-action visual observation resolves exactly the deterministic postcondition before VERIFIED_SUCCESS.
No built-in Safari visual fallback contract is shipped or enabled by the discovery.
Screenshot bytes, OCR payloads and coordinates are not persisted in evidence.
Cleanup and Computer Use/Computer Control tree cleanliness pass.

s01.reason: PoC oracle incorrectly treated P3A ok=true for VISUAL_TARGET_UNRESOLVED as proof that the postcondition was present before action. Product and fixture were unchanged.

failureLineage.forwardOnlyFix: The physical oracle now requires state=VISUAL_TARGET_RESOLVED for the target and state=VISUAL_TARGET_UNRESOLVED with NO_EXACT_TEXT_MATCH and matchCount=0 for the pre-action postcondition.

nonClaims: P6B does not validate generic Safari visual fallback or arbitrary canvas safety.
P6B does not ship a built-in Safari contract.
P6B does not change any P1-P6A product behavior or Computer Control delivery mechanics.

evidencePolicy.safariUserState: Block before session creation when Safari is already running; repeat the guard inside the physical test.
evidencePolicy.onFailure: Preserve s02 unchanged, diagnose the exact remaining boundary and create s03 only after a forward-only correction.
evidencePolicy.sensitiveData: Only test-owned loopback page content is used; screenshot bytes, OCR observations and coordinates remain ephemeral.

onPass.nextCheckpoint: P6C evidence-backed bounded Safari caller-contract promotion
